name: Equivalence Queries Complexity of the Three-Code Class
proof: Use the improper proposal $001$. Against the three targets $000,011,101$, its disagreement coordinate is respectively $x_0,x_1,x_2$, and each counterexample identifies the target uniquely. The verifier $\texttt{sync/verify\_properness\_separation.py}$ checks these three response classes. Size zero is impossible for a non-singleton class.
